topic.title: Monitoring CPU temperature in real time
topic.para: To monitor the temperature in real time, run the sensors command with the watch command:
The watch command is part of the procps package. It runs a command at regular intervals and shows its output in the terminal. Sample output:
topic.screen:
Every 2.0s: sensors sles16: 07:23:01 AM in 0.007s (0) nvme-pci-0090 Adapter: PCI adapter Composite: +49.9°C (low = -273.1°C, high = +69.8°C) (crit = +99.8°C)
acpitz-acpi-0 Adapter: ACPI interface temp1: +40.9°C temp2: +52.9°C
topic.para: By default, the watch command updates the output every two seconds. You can change this interval with the -n option followed by the number of seconds. For example, to change the interval to 5 seconds, run:
Press C to stop the watch command.
